title: Gotrade Daily: AI Stocks Slip, Delta Reports Tonight
summary: OpenAI's revenue report weighed on AI stocks as the Nasdaq fell 1%. Tonight: Delta earnings. Watchlist: DAL, NVDA, ORCL, MSFT, XOM.
body_markdown:
Pressure grew after Firmus, an Australian data center operator backed by Nvidia, withdrew its IPO. According to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/09/nvidia-ai-firmus-ipo-.html) , Firmus had planned to raise $5 billion and will now seek capital from private markets.


### October consumer sentiment


Preliminary October consumer sentiment data comes out in the US morning, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . It offers a read on how US households view the economy.


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


S&P 500 futures rose 0.3% and Nasdaq 100 futures added 0.49% early Friday, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . SoftBank Group shares in Tokyo fell more than 6% after the OpenAI report.


## Macro Note 📝


On Thursday, Brent rose 4% to top $104 a barrel, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/09/trump-iran-war-gas-openai-nvidia-microsoft-.html) . Early Friday, Brent fell 0.77% to $103.48 after President Trump said the US will not attack Iran before the midterm elections, according to[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/08/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . The 10-year Treasury yield stood at 5.227%.


## Conclusion


OpenAI's report shows the market remains sensitive to news about AI-sector revenue. The Nasdaq fell for a second straight day after setting records earlier this week.


Delta's results and tonight's consumer sentiment data are worth following for a read on market direction into the weekend.
